svg.aria-label: Hertzsprung-Russell diagram of the MESA track that Stellar Explorer shows: a one-solar-mass, solar-metallicity star from the pre-main sequence through the main sequence, the red-giant branch, the helium flash, the red clump and the asymptotic giant branch to the white-dwarf cooling track. Faint diagonal lines mark constant radius.
svg.text: surface temperature (K), hotter to the left
